title: Canonical 104-framed C_SC_NA_1 activation execute
purpose: Provide a compact canonical IEC 60870-5-104 I-format APDU carrying a single command activation with one information object and a minimal execute-form qualifier.
expected_behavior: A 104-capable parser should accept the APDU framing, parse a one-object C_SC_NA_1 ASDU, and dispatch it as an activation-style single command with a minimal qualifier.
constraints_preserved: APDU start byte is 0x68 as documented
APDU length 0x0f matches the 15 bytes following the length byte
ASDU field order is type_id, vsq, cause_of_transmission, common_address, information_object_address
VSQ count is 1 with sequence flag clear
Cause of transmission uses value 6 activation with two octets present
Common address is two octets in little-endian form
Information object address is three octets in little-endian form
Single command qualifier is appended after the information object address for C_SC_NA_1
issue_safety_notes: No issue enhancement is used. This is a conservative valid framed seed intended as a baseline for later mutation.
